commands.name: check

options.name: --checks
options.description: Only run checks whose code starts with one of these  prefixes, e.g. CHK-IDX.

options.name: --depth
options.description: spine | quick | standard | deep. Default: standard.

options.name: --format
options.description: text | json. Default: text on a terminal, json when  piped.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the report to a file instead of standard  output.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Skip checks whose code starts with one of these  prefixes.

commands.description: Check a database's integrity and report what is  wrong. Read-only.

commands.name: docs

options.name: --print
options.description: Print the URL instead of opening a browser (headless / SSH sessions).

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Optional page under /latest/ to deep-link to, e.g.  "guide/getting-started".

commands.description: Open the Typhon documentation in your browser.

commands.name: new

options.name: --force
options.description: Scaffold even if the target directory already contains files (same-named files are overwritten).

options.name: --output
options.description: Parent directory to create the project in. Default:  the current directory.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of the project to create (a directory of this  name is created).

commands.description: Scaffold a new Typhon starter project.

commands.name: repair

options.name: --allow-loss
options.description: Consent to steps that destroy data that is already  unreadable.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Execute the plan. The only mutating mode.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: With --apply: describe every step and execute none.

options.name: --no-backup-first
options.description: Do not copy the bundle before the first mutation. A  copy is taken by default.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the plan to this file instead of standard  output.

options.name: --plan
options.description: Produce a plan and a loss manifest. Mutates nothing.  This is the default.

commands.description: Plan and apply a repair, with an explicit account of  anything it would cost.

commands.name: trace

options.name: --clear
options.description: Remove the trace output path (stop writing a trace file).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the telemetry config file (default:  ./typhon.telemetry.json).

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: Profiler trace output file (e.g.  captures/app.typhon-trace). Declaring it activates profiling.

commands.name: ui

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Start the host without opening a browser (prints the  URL to open manually).

options.name: --open-db
options.description: Auto-open the *.typhon database in the current  directory on launch (investigate a database).

options.name: --open-latest
options.description: Auto-open the newest *.typhon-trace capture under  ./captures on launch (watch a profile).

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port to bind. Default 5200. Ignored when  --url is given.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Schema assembly (.dll) or a directory containing it,  used to interpret an opened database. When omitted, the app's built  assembly is auto-discovered from ./bin.

options.name: --trace
options.description: Optional .typhon-trace file to auto-open in the  profiler on launch.

options.name: --url
options.description: Full loopback URL to bind (advanced). Default  http://127.0.0.1:5200.

arguments.name: database
arguments.description: Optional .typhon database to open in the initial  Workbench session.

commands.description: Launch the Typhon Workbench UI in your browser.
